1.text: You arrive in a quiet neighborhood at the edge of town. The buildings are older here, but every lawn in sight is pristine.

2.text: You briefly consider sampling some of the nearest lawn for a midday snack. But alas, you've been scolded for that once before. Your boss had called it "unprofessional".

3.text: You shake your head. Stay focused. You scan the area for the house number listed in the file. Ah, there it is.

4.text: You step onto the porch. The wooden boards creak beneath your hooves. From the other side of the door drifts the muffled sounds of music bumping.

7.text: Good afternoon! My name is Bullerton, from Holstein Collections Inc.

8.text: We've been informed that you've been behind on your payments to the Hereford County Energy Department for a while, so I'm here to touch base with you about your options.

9.text: Oh, great. Just what I needed.
